recipe.visualDefinition: A theatrical group portrait set on a dimly lit stage framed by heavy red curtains and a thick orange border. The scene features a group of men in dark jackets and sunglasses standing center-stage, flanked by a woman in a black leotard, all under dramatic spotlighting with a dark, empty auditorium visible in the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Orange outer border framing the entire composition
Theatrical red curtains acting as internal framing for the subjects
High-contrast spotlighting against a deep black background
Large, expressive brush-style lettering floating above the central group
coreInvariants: Deep blue and orange accent lighting on the stage floor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five men occupies the center-right; a single female figure stands to the left. Subjects are full-body, scaled to occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central group of men, specifically the figure in the cowboy hat, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large orange script at the top, move down to the central group, then sweep left to the female figure, and finally to the blue text at the very top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space in the upper center and background auditorium creates depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and black (curtains and background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright orange (border and main title text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan blue (top metadata text and stage floor lights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange and red elements contrasted against low-value, dark shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Expressive brush script and wide geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses thick, gestural brush strokes with visible bristle textures
Top metadata text uses a wide, all-caps geometric sans-serif with high letter spacing
Main title features a slight upward arc and a long, sweeping underline
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' and 'W' in the script have exaggerated, sharp terminals
The 'C' in the top text is perfectly circular

composition.relationshipToImage: superimposed over the dark stage area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-energy gestural script paired with rigid, wide-spaced geometric sans-serif for a professional yet 'funky' look.

avoid: Centered alignment for the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-set metadata text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body group portrait of five men in dark suits and sunglasses standing on a dark stage, with a woman in a black leotard to the left. The scene is framed by heavy red curtains and a thick orange outer border. The background shows a dark, empty theater. Use high-contrast flash lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large orange brush-script text in the upper third with a double-stroke underline. Add a single line of wide-spaced cyan blue geometric sans-serif text along the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the orange border thick and consistent?
Does the script text have a hand-painted brush texture?
Is the top text cyan and widely spaced?
Are the curtains framing the subjects effectively?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the group
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Hand-drawn feel for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange border does not overlap the subjects.
Check that the brush script looks expressive and not like a standard computer font.
Verify the high-contrast lighting creates deep shadows in the background.
Confirm the cyan text is legible against the dark background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Theatrical Stage Portrait + Thick Perimeter Border + Expressive Brush Script + High-Contrast Flash Lighting
